name: Great Barrier Reef
description: Stretching more than 2,300 kilometres off Queensland in north-east Australia, the Great Barrier Reef is the largest coral system on Earth, made of nearly 3,000 separate reefs and about 900 islands. Built by billions of tiny coral polyps, it is visible from space. Beneath the surface live 400 kinds of coral, 1,500 fish species, and threatened dugongs and green turtles.
